subject: French

source.title: Primary School Education Curriculum Design — French, Grade 6 (Revised 2024)
source.notes: Read directly from grade-6-curriculum-desings/GRADE-6-FRENCH-Curriculum-Designs.pdf via the Read tool (no pages param, per standing environment note). Essence statement: foreign language taught non-formally at Upper Primary, targeting basic proficiency equivalent to A1/YCT2. Same 9-theme structure as Grade 7/8/9 French (see curriculum-reference/grade-7/french.json if present, and web/src/skills/frenchG7 and frenchG8), but each theme's 3 strand-level sub-strands sit at ISBN 978-9914-43-996-0. Time allocation: Listening and Speaking 27 lessons, Reading 18 lessons, Writing 9 lessons, +6 lessons showcasing.

subStrands.name: 1.1 Oral expression — Theme 1: Greetings and Introductions
specificLearningOutcomes: exhibit acquisition of an expanded vocabulary when speaking
employ fluency in verbal expression for effective communication
use gestures and facial expressions to enhance oral communication
express enthusiasm to engage in oral communication
keyInquiryQuestions: How do you speak clearly?
learningExperiences: participate in "Repeat-after-me" exercise to acquire vocabulary on greetings and introductions
listen to and sing songs on numbers (1 – 20)
play "mirror-mirror" games for facial expressions and gestures

linkedLearningAreas: English and Kiswahili — vocabulary on basic greetings links to greetings and introductions in English and Kiswahili
subStrands.notes: Numbers 1–20 taught via song within this theme.

assessmentSignal: Listening/Speaking rubric rewards vocabulary breadth, correct pronunciation/intonation/rhythm/pacing, responsiveness to prompts, gestures/facial expressions, and willingness to participate. Reading rubric rewards pronunciation accuracy, fluency (pace/pauses/intonation), and comprehension (interpreting questions in context, using paraphrase). Writing rubric rewards correct spelling/orthography and correct simple-sentence structure, with top band explicitly rewarding successful attempts at MORE COMPLEX sentences beyond the simple-sentence floor.
notes: Grade 6 French has the same 9-theme, 3-strand (Listening and Speaking / Reading / Writing) shape as Grade 7/8/9 French, and the exact same 9 theme names as Grade 7 (Greetings and Introductions, Family, My Surroundings, Time, Fun and Enjoyment, Foods and Drinks, My Body, Weather and Environment, Getting Around) — informal 'tu' register throughout (no formal 'vous' register drilling, unlike Grade 8). Skills built as 27 files in web/src/skills/frenchG6/ (9 themes x 3 strands: Speaking/Reading/Writing), following the exact frenchG7 file/strand/code pattern (strand ids g6-fr-listening-speaking / g6-fr-reading / g6-fr-writing, codes LS.1-9 / R.1-9 / W.1-9).
